ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #20
====

GRADE: PP1
SUBJECT: ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Animals ENVIRONMENT? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Animals ENVIRONMENT.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Animals ENVIRONMENT.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Animals ENVIRONMENT.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Animals ENVIRONMENT.

2. Which practice best shows correct science when studying : OUR SCHOOL? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on : OUR SCHOOL.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for : OUR SCHOOL.

5. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)

   B. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   C. Removing all vegetation

   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Myself ENVIRONMENT.

7. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Paper burning to ash
   B. Milk souring
   C. Ice melting to water
   D. Iron rusting

8. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Only water vapour
   B. Nitrogen gas only
   C. Glucose and oxygen
   D. Only carbon dioxide

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Hand washing PRACTICES? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Hand washing PRACTICES.

12. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   B. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   C. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   D. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Hand washing PRACTICES and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
